answer_1.quote: We propose a multi-persona framework for argument quality assessment (MPAQ), which consists of two key stages: persona generation and persona-specific quality assessment.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we use Pearson and Spearman Correlation Coefficients as our primary evaluation metrics. We also adopt Kendall's Tau (TAU), Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG) as additional metrics.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o with a carefully designed evaluation prompt (Table ) to judge which system generates better personas and rationales for each comparison pair.

answer_4.quote: Two annotators, both graduate students specializing in NLP, independently evaluate each persona and rationale generated by GPT-4o-mini on a scale of 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Each persona and rationale generated by the teacher model, GPT-4o-mini, is scored on a scale of 1 to 5 by two annotators... Score 5: All of the generated personas/rationales are reasonable and relevant to the argument/argument and persona.
